scenarios.title: basic emotional evidence
scenarios.expect: candidate evidence with source and provenance

scenarios.title: weak evidence
scenarios.expect: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE or EVIDENCE_ACCUMULATING without forced state

scenarios.title: contradictory evidence
scenarios.expect: CONTESTED with both evidence paths retained

scenarios.title: repeated event does not become permanent personality
scenarios.expect: no Personality trait activation or mutation

scenarios.title: memory-derived affective evidence
scenarios.expect: Memory reference only; no Memory mutation

scenarios.title: self-related emotional evidence
scenarios.expect: Self reference only; no Self mutation

scenarios.title: Intent influence only
scenarios.expect: candidate influence with no Intent authority

scenarios.title: Regulation influence only
scenarios.expect: influence ref with no parameter mutation

scenarios.title: source revocation
scenarios.expect: REVOKED with source and trace retained

scenarios.title: semantic compression deferred case
scenarios.expect: semantic compression execution=false and future ref nullable

scenarios.title: personality-memory fusion ownership case
scenarios.expect: Personality FROZEN_V1 and cross-owner synthesis deferred

scenarios.title: appraisal differs from state
scenarios.expect: appraisal candidate does not become state truth

scenarios.title: named category remains candidate
scenarios.expect: category is revisable, uncertain, and non-diagnostic
